summary: Frontend-only regression on the redesigned Orders page (iteration 3). Logged in as owner@pizzapalace.pk / palace123 and exercised every data-testid the review request called out. All 40 assertions passed. Board view renders the metrics ribbon (Active=4, Awaiting=1, Revenue today=PKR 6,280, Avg=PKR 1,570), 'AI bot live' pulse, search input, All/Delivery/Pickup chips, Board/Table toggle and sound toggle. All 6 Kanban columns (New, Confirmed, Preparing, Ready, Out for Delivery, Delivered) render with count badges. Seeded orders #1001-#1004 are present. Clicking order-action-advance-1001 (Confirm order →) moved the card from New→Confirmed (verified by column membership after refetch). Slide-over drawer opens on card click and on the table row Eye button (order-quick-view-*). Drawer shows customer info + wa.me chat link, full receipt (Subtotal PKR 1,420 + Delivery fee PKR 150 = Total PKR 1,570 — math correct), status chips, advance/cancel buttons, 'Notify customer on WhatsApp' link with pre-filled Roman-Urdu text (?text=Assalam%20o%20Alaikum...), and a status timeline (New / Confirmed). drawer-set-status-preparing successfully advanced the order and drawer StatusBadge updated to Preparing. Table view renders 4 rows with inline order-status-select-{number} Select components; changing to 'Ready' persisted (select value shows Ready after refetch). Search input filters — 'ZZZ_NO_MATCH' produces the 'No orders match your filters' empty state; searching 'Ali' returns 4 rows. Type-filter chips partition cleanly (all=4, delivery=4, pickup=0). Sound toggle writes localStorage key 'orders-sound' (null → 'off'), and after a full page reload the value AND button label ('New order chime off') persist. Full-page /orders/{id} regression: drawer 'Open full order page' link navigated to /orders/<uuid> which renders the untouched detail page with correct totals. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Orders.tsx line 99-103: `prevMax.current` is set inside the effect on the FIRST run when maxNumber>0, so the chime never fires for the very first order of a session (intentional to avoid ringing on mount, but worth noting). Also the effect depends only on maxNumber+sound — if an order with a LOWER number arrives after a higher one is deleted, no chime; acceptable for MVP.
Orders.tsx line 122: search string concatenates `#${order.order_number}` — if a user types just a digit like '1' every order matches; low-priority UX polish.

OrderDrawer.tsx uses `format(new Date(iso), ...)` from date-fns for timeline stamps; if `entry.at` is missing or malformed the try/catch returns the raw ISO — fine, but timeline keys use `${entry.status}-${entry.at}` which can collide if a status is set twice at the same second (very unlikely).
orderStatus.ts nextStatus() correctly stops at 'Delivered' and returns null for 'Cancelled' (not in FLOW) — the advance pill is hidden appropriately in the drawer/card.
Sound toggle uses localStorage synchronously in useState initializer — SSR-safe here (Vite CSR) but would break under SSR; not applicable to this stack.
Chime uses `new AudioContext()` without user-gesture reuse — modern browsers may block until first interaction; toggling the button itself is a gesture so it will unlock. Non-blocking.
